author: Vivian Chow
title: Student with loaded firearm arrested after fleeing Orange County high school - NewsBreak
text:
By Vivian Chow No media credit provided. ,
3 hours ago A student who was reportedly found with a loaded firearm was arrested after fleeing the campus of a high school in Westminster.
On April 28, a school resource officer at La Quinta High School responded to reports of a student vaping on campus around 10 a.m.
The student was found and escorted to the principal’s office, but refused to allow a search of his bag, officers said. The teen ran off campus soon after.
Officers eventually located the student nearby and detained him. While searching his belongings, they reportedly found a loaded firearm.
La Quinta High School at 10372 W McFadden Ave. in Westminster, Orange County, California. (Google Maps) Authorities confirmed that the gun did not have a serial number and identified it as a “ghost gun,” the Orange County Register reported.
Investigators also searched the student’s home, but no additional firearms were found.
The teen was arrested on weapons-related charges and booked into Orange County Juvenile Hall. His identity was withheld due to his minor status.
